source_scope: POROTHERM/Wienerberger low-rise technical album, physical pages 1-105; canonical technical-detail sheets pages 21-25,27-34,36-38,40-42,44-58,60-67,69-73,75-79,81-89,91-99,101-102,104
critical_findings: The v2.2 generic extraction counted 69 POROTHERM records and included section-divider pages while omitting multiple actual detail sheets. v2.3 establishes 73 canonical technical-detail sheets and excludes 12 divider pages from buildable detail cards.

The source table of contents says section 1 is sheets 1.1-1.4, but physical page 25 has an actual title block for sheet 1.5. v2.3 preserves the discrepancy and treats the physical title block as the canonical sheet identity.
The old POROTHERM facts misparsed product text 25M as a 25 m dimension. Those five POROTHERM v2.2 facts are removed and replaced by source-bound catalogue/global facts.
Tables 2, 3 and 5 plus page 104 are represented as parametric catalog entries for POROTHERM blocks, TERCA facing bricks, masonry mortars, reinforcement meshes and anchor A-1.
All sheet-specific drawing dimensions remain an explicit 73-item binding queue. No dimension was derived from raster pixel scale.
Source title typos such as PHOROTERM/СТЕПЫ/ПРЕМЫКАНИЕ are preserved as source literals while normalized semantic roles remain separate.
Old SP/GOST/SNiP citations are stored only as claimed_by_source and are not asserted to be current.
